title: a checkpoint, its log lines, and the full-page image the next change writes
setup:
CREATE TABLE notes (id int, body text NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO notes SELECT g, 'note ' || g || ': ' || repeat('.', 40) FROM generate_series(1, 60) AS g;

steps.note: CHECKPOINT writes every dirty buffer out, fsyncs the files, then logs where redo would start.

records.desc: redo 0/1620A38; tli 1; prev tli 1; fpw true; wal_level replica; xid 0:759; oid 24576; multi 1; offset 0; oldest xid 744 in DB 1; oldest multi 1 in DB 1; oldest/newest commit timestamp xid: 0/0; oldest running xid 759; online

log: LOG:  checkpoint starting: immediate force wait

LOG:  checkpoint complete: wrote 165 buffers (1.0%), wrote 3 SLRU buffers; 0 WAL file(s) added, 0 removed, 0 recycled; write=<t> s, sync=<t> s, total=<t> s; sync files=72, longest=<t> s, average=<t> s; distance=883 kB, estimate=883 kB; lsn=0/1620A90, redo lsn=0/1620A38

steps.sql: UPDATE notes SET body = 'changed once' WHERE id = 1
steps.note: the first change to page 0 since the checkpoint: the WAL record carries a copy of the whole page.

records.desc: old_xmax: 759, old_off: 1, old_infobits: [], flags: 0x20, new_xmax: 0, new_off: 61

steps.sql: UPDATE notes SET body = 'changed twice' WHERE id = 2
steps.note: a second change to the same page: the page is already in the log since the checkpoint, so only the change goes in.

records.desc: old_xmax: 760, old_off: 2, old_infobits: [], flags: 0x20, new_xmax: 0, new_off: 62

steps.note: another checkpoint. the redo pointer moves past both updates.

records.desc: redo 0/1621FF0; tli 1; prev tli 1; fpw true; wal_level replica; xid 0:761; oid 24576; multi 1; offset 0; oldest xid 744 in DB 1; oldest multi 1 in DB 1; oldest/newest commit timestamp xid: 0/0; oldest running xid 761; online

log: LOG:  checkpoint starting: immediate force wait

LOG:  checkpoint complete: wrote 1 buffers (0.0%), wrote 1 SLRU buffers; 0 WAL file(s) added, 0 removed, 0 recycled; write=<t> s, sync=<t> s, total=<t> s; sync files=2, longest=<t> s, average=<t> s; distance=5 kB, estimate=796 kB; lsn=0/1622060, redo lsn=0/1621FF0

steps.sql: UPDATE notes SET body = 'changed again' WHERE id = 3
steps.note: the first change since the new checkpoint pays for a full page again.

records.desc: old_xmax: 761, old_off: 3, old_infobits: [], flags: 0x20, new_xmax: 0, new_off: 63
